rationale: All nonzero colors are eligible sources and every ray direction is active. Stop policy 1 halts before the first non-background pixel, matching the examples where rays from the edge sources appear to stop at other colored cells; absent a positive paint entry, each ray uses its source color. The tile layer repeats a 2-by-2 arrangement: identity in the upper-left, horizontal flip upper-right, vertical flip lower-left, and 180-degree rotation lower-right. The remaining orientation slots follow a consistent positional pattern.
